description: Header file defining the AccessChecker class implementing access control logic for a Kuksa VSS server, including methods for checking read/write access and path permissions.

classes.name: AccessChecker
classes.description: Implements IAccessChecker interface to perform security checks and manage access control for channels and paths.

methods.name: AccessChecker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AccessChecker with a token validator.

methods.name: checkReadAccess
methods.description: Checks if read access is permitted for a given channel and path.

methods.name: checkWriteAccess
methods.description: Checks if write access is permitted for a given channel and path.

methods.name: checkPathWriteAccess
methods.description: Checks if write access to multiple paths via JSON object is permitted for a given channel.
